title: ZTIE static-scan summary data contract (v1.2)
description: The derived static-scan SUMMARY produced by the Story 2.1 static lane (+ the Story 2.2 signature engine + the Story 2.2G gitleaks secret scanner) for one intake artifact, and the ONLY static-lane shape allowed to cross the Forensic -> Hub boundary (RD-013) — the fifth envelope kind on the Hub gate. v1.1 (Story 2.2) additively added the 'signature-scan' tool to the per-tool status + an OPTIONAL bounded 'compliance' roll-up (control id -> count, per framework, + mapped/unmapped totals). v1.2 (Story 2.2G) additively adds the 'gitleaks' tool to the per-tool status enum (the SOLE secret scanner; it supersedes the 2.2 embedded SECRET regex rules). The full normalized findings document + the per-finding mapping rationale stay in Forensic (RD-009); this summary carries only bounded, derived counts + a pointer back to it. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level (except the two control->count maps, whose keys are the framework catalogue and whose values are bounded ints); every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY: no raw body / finding text / resource names / rationale. ZERO-TRUST: a scan summary is EVIDENCE, never a verdict — no verdict/safe/approved/forward field; highest_severity is a descriptive roll-up, not a decision; a compliance count says findings implicate a control, never that the artifact fails; the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). NON-EXECUTING (RD-001).

contract_version.description: Summary-contract schema version. Pinned so the Hub validator rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed. '1.2' (Story 2.2G) is the current emitted version; '1.0' (Story 2.1) and '1.1' (Story 2.2) are accepted for read-compat but the lane now emits 1.2.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this scan summary is for. The Hub upserts the summary onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body the scan ran over. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub rejects a summary whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

scanned_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the scan completed in Forensic.

scan.description: The derived scan summary: what ran, how much it found, the worst severity, and a pointer to the full findings document in Forensic. EVIDENCE only — never a verdict.

artifact_class.description: The class label the tool selection was based on (from the Story 1.2 classification).

non_executing.description: Always true. The static lane inspects; it never executes the artifact (RD-001).

tools.description: Per-tool run status + finding count. tools_run and tools_errored are derivable from this (status field).

status.description: 'ok' = the tool ran to completion (possibly zero findings); 'error' = the tool failed. An error is recorded, not fatal — the lane does not crash on a scanner error.

total_findings.description: Total findings across all tools (true pre-truncation count, even if the stored findings document was capped).

highest_severity.description: The worst normalized severity across all findings, or 'none' when there were zero findings. A descriptive roll-up of EVIDENCE — NOT a verdict.

findings_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the full normalized findings document (RD-009 — the full document stays in Forensic; only this pointer crosses).

findings_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full normalized findings document (findings/<intake_id>/static-findings.json).

findings_truncated.description: True iff the stored findings document was capped; the counts here remain the true pre-truncation totals.

compliance.description: Story 2.2 — bounded compliance roll-up: how many findings implicated each distinct control, per framework, plus mapped/unmapped totals. Derived EVIDENCE only — no finding text, no rationale, NO verdict. The full per-finding mapping stays in the Forensic findings document (RD-009); only these counts cross.

nist_800_53.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control id -> count of findings implicating it.

iso_27001.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control id -> count of findings implicating it.

mapped_findings.description: Count of findings that carried a (proposed/ratified) control mapping.

unmapped_findings.description: Count of findings with no honest control mapping (basis unmapped).

mapping_version.description: Version of the mapping table used, for traceability.
